description: Snap a point to the nearest position on a line or route. Returns the closest point on the line and the distance to it. Useful for "which point on this route is closest to my location?" or map-matching without the API. Works offline without API calls.

point.description: The point to snap to the line

name: nearest_point_on_line_tool

distance.description: Distance from the input point to the nearest point on the line

location.description: Distance along the line to the nearest point

nearest.description: The nearest point on the line

title: Nearest Point on Line
